notablePrerequisites:
Illusionist's Bracers attached to Blossom Dryad.
Blossom Dryad does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it.
Illusionist's Bracer triggers, copying Blossom Dryad's ability, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blossom Dryad's ability, untapping any other land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding one mana of any color that land can produce.
